budget_unit: Original Qwen2.5 tokenizer; word/punctuation footprint separate

unsupported.bge_embeddings: No implemented embedding adapter, model ID or cached weights.
unsupported.minilm_cross_encoder: Only all-MiniLM-L6-v2 bi-encoder is implemented; no cross-encoder adapter, model ID or cached weights.

definitions.raw_budget: Original retrieval order, whole-passage first-fit under the identical token budget.
definitions.raw_full: Unfiltered unbudgeted reference, 24 cases; excluded from budgeted aggregate rankings.
definitions.omneum: Exact production prepare_context(question=...), default lexical passage relevance, full graph. No embeddings or scorer substitutions.
definitions.cohere_omneum: Production complementary density configuration with cached raw Cohere reranker scores, top3 plus ties, depth2.
definitions.cached_provider_latency: Historical request samples, n=24 Cohere and n=48 per frontier judge; not repeated fresh API evaluations.
definitions.local_latency: Post-supplied-ranking wall time; includes fresh SDK graph for Omneum. Standalone intrinsic lexical relevance is included. Model initialization/daemon startup/loading excluded.
definitions.quality: Same tier1_metrics.measure definitions and canonical annotations as the completed local run. Strict gold-claim labels are absent; supporting-passage claim coverage is explicitly separate.
definitions.cost: No new paid API calls. Historical inference costs remain unknown, not zero; historical pricing is not invented.
